text.p: Shares of Austrian brick maker Wienerberger Baustoffindustrie rose 0.7 percent in an otherwise limp Vienna market after the group said 1996 net profit fell 26 percent to 800 million schillings.
Traders said the results had already been priced into the shares. "The figures were more or less in line with expectations," said one.
At 0835 GMT, the shares were up 15 schillings at 2,265.0. The ATX index of 21 blue chips was up 0.05 percent at 1,194.78 at the same time.

Wienerberger forecast group pretax profit to rise to 1.7 billion schillings in the current year from 1.37 billion a year earlier as the European building materials industry was forecast to emerge from last year's slump. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
